text.text_excerpt: I've been meaning to try this place out for quite a while and finally made it in. Went in on a Saturday at about 1:15 & it wasn't super busy. I think I had just missed the lunch time rush as they were out of a few items. I decided to try the V-spot burger, which had a plant based patty, vegan queso, their VWAT sauce, spinach, grilled onions, and tomato. It comes with a side of fries as well. The burger was food and flavorful and I loved the kick the sauce had. I'd definitely order it again. It was just a tad lukewarm so I'd like it a bit hotter. The fries were yummy and they were crinkle cut, which I love. I also tried one of their lemonades. I got strawberry at the suggestion of the woma...

I've seen the articles on social media about three barbers starting a vegan restaurant and I've been interested in giving it a chance. At work I sometimes get plant based burgers but I'm usually pretty carnivorous. After seeing several post of different entrees from VWAT, I reviewed the menu and settled on Da Pressure Burger. Living in NOLA will have you appreciative of spices. The burger was actually more sweet than spicy and definitely have napkins on hand because it can get kind of messy. Overall the flavor was there and I enjoyed my choice. We all know fries have a lifespan of 10 mins so no judgments were passed when I bit into the first soggy fry. I've had vegan wit a twist a few times delivery and it is always great! Their food is consistently amazing and completely 100% vegan (THANK YOU VEGAN WIT A TWIST!!!). I just got a chance to stop by in person for the first time and wow!!!! What a great space! They have pens so you can write on the walls and there's TONS of inspirational stuff from before and after Covid started. It was fun to read and take in everything written by fellow loving vegans while we waited (not long!) for our food. I've had their burgers before (da pressure burger is to DIE FOR!).
